notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi, OdiPals! Firstly, thanks for all your feedback and comments for this update. We're so grateful to you for supporting us during this first phase of development. This week we've update OdiChat demo with those news: 🍃 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299396/b00cf1dff9d8fa393982220159a68c27d57aae3e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Shorten content:[/b] Our previous demo had a bit of the full-game story (Tea & Trend channel) which made the demo really long at almost 1h of gameplay! Crazy right? When a demo is this long it usually doesn't perform as well so we had to shorten it, but this give us place to the following new content and features
[*] We added new chats, characters and pictures so you can connect with new ones.
[*] [b]NEW FEATURE: [/b] Try groups videocalls! Try this new way to connect with Serenity, Bean, Neptune and Mikan. 💖
[/list]
Enjoy the new demo and remember that adding us to your wishlist means support to the OdiChat team. 💚 #otome #visualnovel #anime

notes.title: OdiChat Demo on the Visual Novel Fest!
notes.notes:
[h2]"I’m Odi, your bunny assistant designed with high resolution tech just to help you!"[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299396/9bd883e2310d570714e59f416a67a846c25445a9.png[/img]

Odi is an AI that has created OdiChat cozy virtual platform to help people make friends and special connections. It focuses on creating a cozy community where people can share their stories and connect with one another.

Choose dialogue options, connect with people, meet love, and discuss topics like relationships and mental health in a safe and welcoming environment with the other group members while you listen to some lofi beats. Also, OdiChat is an LGBTQ+ otome visual novel, so all the characters can become a romantic interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44299396/a9422789ea6e20b8b1b8aa775a54ea1ba5b5b9c4.png[/img]

[h2]Try the Demo![/h2] 
From 7 - 14 Aug, during Steam Visual Novel Fest, play the demo and experience a cozy and lovely time with Serenity, Tenshi, Axai, and other members on OdiChat's server.
